title: Death of Bill Steinman

tellings.quote: He died in January a couple years ago. Massive heart attack. Sheila was in the kitchen.

plain: A UFO researcher named Bill Steinman is said to have died near Goodyear, Arizona, of a massive heart attack one January a few years back, while his wife Sheila Steinman was in the kitchen. Scott Ramsey, a researcher who has looked into a claimed crash of a craft carrying alien bodies, tells this as what Sheila Steinman told him.
